criteria.requirement: Implement jmespath.bound.BoundExpression(expression,options=None) with read-only expression and search(data,options=sentinel). Compile once, snapshot Options dict_cls/custom_functions references at binding so later mutation of the Options container does not change defaults, and create the normal interpreter per call. Omitted override uses binding, explicit None uses standard defaults, explicit Options affects one call. Retain custom function object identity, actual parser/errors and input field semantics; require completed literal isolation so callers cannot poison repeated template results.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
